panels.description: Alex braces the collapsed frame while TJ's detached head reaches the release mechanism. Keep both rescue actions readable and leave upper space.
A cold search beam sweeps toward Alex and Tomas across the Site 6 machinery. B11 remains farther back; leave upper dark space for dialogue.
Alex shifts his grip and lifts while Tomas pulls free from the frame. Keep the rescue silhouette clear and leave upper space for impact lettering.
B11 faces Alex after the beam turns back, amber eyes steady and brass ring visible. Leave upper space for the admission.

items.speaker: B11
items.text: Leave him. The beam will pass us.

items.speaker: B11
items.text: I predicted we could leave him unseen.
